verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents two credential types: long-lived server API keys (rainforest-docs-25) and short-lived component sessions capped at 24 hours (rainforest-docs-24). The sessions offer some time-bounded, narrower access, but the evidence never shows permission scoping or least-privilege controls on API keys, nor any guidance for agent use. Missing for 10: documented per-key permission or scope restrictions, resource- or merchant-level credential scoping, agent-specific credential guidance, independent corroboration.
